gap: No result ChatGPT got states that techtest.org put the Anker Prime 200W (A2683) under a 2× 100 W load from two electronic loads and it could not hold it: after about 1.5 hours it throttled to 70 W per port. The same lab ran UGREEN's Nexode 200W 6-port (CD271) at 2× 100 W (20 V/5 A) for about 6 hours without problems.
standout_why: I compared against computingforgeeks.com/best-gan-charger-laptop (it says its chargers 'weren't tested with a USB-C power meter' and calls the Anker Prime 200W's 100 W per port 'the one firm promise'), androidauthority.com's best-chargers list (it only repeats that the Prime 200W 'can deliver up to 100W from two ports at once'), Macworld's Anker Prime 250W review by Simon Jary (2024-08-30, rated specs only), and Anker's and Satechi's own pages and manuals (rated tables). None of them has a sustained two-port load measurement for any candidate. Our own current page mentions a throttle on the Prime 250W but names no tester, so it fails the named-judgement rule.
decides: The Anker Prime 200W (A2683) was ChatGPT's 'My pick' in 3 of the 7 chats, mostly on the strength of '100W + 100W confirmed by Anker'. A named lab measured that it holds 100 W + 100 W for only about 1.5 h before dropping to 70 W + 70 W. That makes it fine for topping up but not for two laptops running all day. The UGREEN Nexode 200W 6-port desktop (CD271) is the only candidate a named lab measured holding 2× 100 W (about 6 h). So for 'fast-charge two laptops at 100 W each at the same time', the measured pick is the UGREEN CD271, and the Anker A2683 needs a caveat.

findings.label: Sustained 2× 100 W load (techtest.org, Michael Barton)
findings.value: Could not hold 2× 100 W: after about 1.5 h it interrupted the load and throttled to 70 W per port (140 W total)
findings.source_title: Anker Prime 200W Ladegerät im Test: High-End Power für alle Geräte?
findings.note: Published 2024-07-25. Load came from two electronic loads set to Anker's 2× 100 W rating. Quote: 'Leider konnte das Anker Ladegerät nicht konstant 2x 100 W liefern!' … 'Nach rund 1,5 Stunden … drosselte sich auf je 70 W pro Port.' No temperatures given; the author says it did not feel very hot outside. 70 W is 30% below the 100 W per-port rating.

findings.label: Sustained 2× 100 W load (techtest.org, Michael Barton)

findings.source_title: Das UGREEN Nexode 200W USB C Ladegerät im Test
findings.note: Published 2023-03-27. Model CD271: 4× USB-C and 2× USB-A, desktop. 'problemlos überstanden'. No temperature figures; the author describes it as 'halbwegs kühl'. The author says an early run was near fans and the test was repeated away from airflow. Same lab and author as the Anker A2683 test, so the two are directly comparable. Best Buy's '$89.99 UGREEN Nexode 6-Port 200W' card in ChatGPT's answer is likely this model, but I did not verify the SKU.

findings.label: Sustained 200 W load (techtest.org, Michael Barton)
findings.value: Constant 200 W for about 8 h; efficiency 77.9% at 5 W to 92.2% at full load
findings.source_title: UGREEN 200W 8-Port GaN Ladegerät im Test: Die günstige Power-Station für den Schreibtisch
findings.note: Published 2025-09-27. The article does not give the port split for the 200 W load. Per its port list, only C1–C3 reach 100 W (the others are 30 W, 15 W and 15 W), so 200 W needs at least two 100 W ports, but exactly 100 W + 100 W is not stated. This is the product family Macworld reviewed (rank-8 result) without measurements.
